headline: UAH win the conference's opening match at West Alabama
dek: UAH went to West Alabama for the first conference match of the season and won, their fourth win from four matches. They have conceded two goals in those four; West Alabama, who have yet to win, have now lost four.
displaced_by: Conference play opened with UAH's win at West Alabama

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring at the top is still shared: UAH's twelve goals have come from eight different players.

wire.line: UAH and Trevecca, both still unbeaten, meet each other in the first week of conference play.
